help_text:
Usage: /media/user/Data/TimeLearnerRefactor/runtime-n1-coupled-sdk-a4/NeuroModelerConsole [options]
NeuroModelerConsole automation arguments

Options:
  -h, --help                                     Displays help on commandline
                                                 options.
  --help-all                                     Displays help including Qt
                                                 specific options.
  -c, --config <path>                            Path to project ini to open.
  -s, --start-calc                               Start calculations immediately
                                                 after launch.
  -t, --calc-time <seconds>                      Calculation time interval in
                                                 seconds.
  -x, --exit-after-calc                          Exit application after
                                                 calculations finish.
  -S, --save-project                             Save project (Model +
                                                 Parameters + Interface) before
                                                 exit.
  -g, --generate-cldesc                          Generate XML descriptions for
                                                 loaded component classes and
                                                 exit.
  -l, --cldesc-lexicon <path>                    Optional path to custom
                                                 lexicon JSON used during
                                                 description generation.
  -C, --cldesc-library <name>                    Limit generation to the
                                                 specified library name (can be
                                                 repeated).
  -K, --cldesc-class <class>                     Limit generation to the
                                                 specified component class name
                                                 (can be repeated).
  -F, --cldesc-force                             Force overwrite of existing
                                                 headers/descriptions when
                                                 generating ClDesc.
  --check-config, --validate-config <path>       Validate configuration file
                                                 and exit with error code.
  --app-ini <path>                               Application ini containing
                                                 explicit resource paths.
  --inspect-model <json-path>                    Write effective loaded model
                                                 readback and exit without
                                                 calculation.
  --model-identity <json-path>                   Write semantic model identity
                                                 and exit without calculation.
  --timelearner-calibrate <json-path>            Execute a declared native
                                                 threshold calibration job.
  --timelearner-posttune <json-path>             Execute declared measured
                                                 PostTune and real threshold
                                                 confirmation.
  --timelearner-output <directory>               New native TimeLearner
                                                 artifact directory.
  --timelearner-train <json-path>                Execute a declared cold native
                                                 training job.
  --timelearner-probe <json-path>                Measure one native input on an
                                                 explicit cold model without
                                                 training or certification.
  --timelearner-preflight <json-path>            Build and validate a cold
                                                 native training job without
                                                 calculating or starting Train.
  --timelearner-capture-directory <directory>    Owned supervisor capture
                                                 directory; native jobs only.
  --timelearner-export <json-path>               Export a completed solo model
                                                 to recognition state.
  --timelearner-evaluate <json-path>             Execute a declared frozen
                                                 evaluation job.
  --timelearner-diagnostic-evaluate <json-path>  Measure an explicitly
                                                 diagnostic frozen model from
                                                 stopped Train; never a
                                                 completed-training result.
